calibration.note: Does not change argmax, so accuracy is unaffected and only confidence is corrected.

abstention.selection_rule: Lowest threshold whose accuracy-on-accepted reaches 95% on a validation set that includes simulated field photographs, floored at the 1.25% quantile of validation confidence so abstention can never be disabled outright.
abstention.selected_on: CS-D validation split rendered as simulated field photographs

superseded_rule.rule: the 5% quantile of in-distribution validation confidence
superseded_rule.why_superseded: It was chosen when validation contained only studio photographs, where the accuracy-target rule degenerated to 0. It answers 'how confident is this model normally?' rather than 'when is this model wrong?'. On studio confidences it produced a floor of 0.9976, which rejected roughly two thirds of both cross-dataset sets, including images the model had in fact classified correctly.

tests.test_set: Test 4 — CS-D test groups, SIMULATED field conditions

no_cross_dataset_evidence_note: Neither class appears in any external dataset in the audited corpus. Their only numbers come from Test 1, which shares CS-D's domain, preprocessing and capture conditions. They are NOT cross-dataset validated and must not be described as such.

steps: leaf matted from the studio background (bright + unsaturated + border-connected), feathered
composited onto an out-of-focus canopy: 3-7 MATTED donor leaves per donor, blurred and darkened, over a mottled shade/litter base
0-2 distractor leaves behind the subject, 45% chance of one partly occluding in front
subject scaled to 45-95% of frame and randomly placed, so the leaf does not fill the image
directional shading gradient (depth 0.15-0.6) plus 1-4 blown-out sunflecks (65%)
Gaussian sensor noise sigma 2-11 (50%), JPEG quality 28-80 (60%)

domain_note: CS-D, EWU and TLD-BD are all studio sets: a detached leaf on white paper or cloth, evenly lit, filling the frame. None of them is field imagery, and an earlier version of this report described TLD-BD as a field set, which was wrong. Test 4 is simulated and is not evidence about real photographs; the real-field number is unmeasured.
never_pool_note: The test sets measure different things and are never combined into a single headline metric.
